name: parotid-atlas
description: Interactive Parotid Surgery Atlas: a scroll-controlled 3D anatomical explanation of parotid tumours and parotidectomy.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run validate && npm run build
scripts.capture: npm run build && npm run capture -w @atlas/capture
scripts.perf: npm run build && npm run perf -w @atlas/capture
